verdict.rationale: There is no first-party pricing documentation in the pack. Community reports indirectly confirm per-unit metering: one team describes Algolia's price-per-search model as costly for live-search UIs, another hit record limits when replica indices multiplied 30K records into 150K, and a third found large indexes too expensive at scale. That suggests usage-based units exist, but nothing shows published rates a founder could use to forecast cost. missing for 10: a first-party published pricing page with per-search/per-record rates, documented plan tiers and free-tier limits, a cost calculator or estimation guidance, and independent confirmation that costs are predictable before committing.
